statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-109518 (DSA-6607-1): an on-path attacker who can manipulate HTTP traffic between an APT client and an archive server, including a malicious mirror or proxy, could get an unverified package installed and run code as root, through hard-link reuse when APT follows redirects and retries package downloads; it needs a non-zero Acquire::Retries, which defaults to 3. Debian fixed it in trixie in apt 3.0.4: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-109518, https://www.debian.org/security/2026/dsa-6607, https://salsa.debian.org/apt-team/apt/-/commit/5af16a8ad0f155233dfb10b7c92ad1903112ef79 (methods: open target files exclusively). We checked the Debian changelog shipped in the DHI apt packages on amd64 and arm64: the builds of apt 3.0.3 carry no entry for this CVE, and the first DHI build of apt 3.0.4 includes Debian's 3.0.4 security update, which lists CVE-2026-109518. Every DHI apt build from 3.0.4 on carries the fix. This owner will be reassessed once apt is rebuilt under the DHI Debian version scheme that carries the Debian release.
